book.name: 2 MAKOLINTE
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no wiili ku MAKOLINTE

content: Oufumu no Mebo mu Tucoo no Limaa
Cwalehe, aba tuli ni situlo mu makeke a Nyambe, tulese okuzwafa.

Na tusiyi einu eyo yenisa eyo ishwekilwe, ka twende mu tingana no kwiiba simba okuwaneka eliywi lya Nyambe kono mu kumonahaza eniti kame tufanena oukubeeka twenyene elizwalo lya munu yonje mu miyo a Nyambe.
Cwale simba nji eliywi no kuwaba lyetu nali shwekiwa, kame li shweekelwe awo afa.
Mu taba yoo onyambe no litunga lino kame ana fokolisa etingana tawo no kwapumena okwaulwisa okumona eliseli no liywi no kuwaba no kanya ya Kelisite woyo oli mu sifekiso sa Nyambe.
Kakuli eyo tukutaza kayetu, kono Jesu Kelesite mukutenda Mbumu, naaci aba tuli abika enu mulibaka lya Jesu.
Kakuli Nyambe yo naamba nji, “Mulesele eliseli litundise ouwi!” woyo ona monisa mu micima yetu okutuba eliseli no zibo no kanya ya Nyambe mu lubala lwa Kelesite.
Kono kame tuli ni ufumu mu tucoo no limaa no litunga, okumonisa nji amaata kame ali kwa Nyambe mi kasa kwaaci.
Kame tuyanda mu mukwa onje, kono katu honehe, kame tuna ziyelehe, kono katu bwelwe esepo,
kame tu yandisiwa, kono ka tu fulalelwa, kame tu kwisetwa banji, kono katusinyehe.
Enako yonje kame tushimbile elifu lya Jesu mu tinyutu tetu, nji cwale omoyo wa Jesu omonahale mu tinyutu tetu.
Kakuli aci me tuyoya, kame tu twaliwa ku lifu mulibaka lya Jesu, nji cwale omoyo wa Jesu omonahale mu lutu lwetu olo lufa.
Cwale elifu kame lisebeza mwaaci, kono omoyo kame osebeza mwaanyi.
Kakuli kame tuli ni mebo imweya no tumelo kanyi woyo onaku n̄ola nji, “Kame nina pumene, mi cwale kame ni naamba.” naaci natu pumene ngeso mi cwale kame twamba.
Kame tuyii nji woyo ona kwingula Ombumu Jesu kwaafu mba twingula ngeeso naaci kwaafu bamweya ni Jesu nikutulita naanyi balubala lwaye.
Kakuli einu yonje kame itendiwa mulibaka lyenu nji cwale esishemo sekeze mukupula kwaanu no kupula nji ifanene okwekeza oukutumela ku kanya ya Nyambe.
Okuyoya mulibaka no Tumelo
Cwale tulese okuzwafa. Ounu wetu na kundee kame usinyeha, kono ounu wetu namukaci kame ushemunwa ba liywaa ni liywaa.
Kakuli amayando etu no kucaniba kame atulukiseta kuneneba no kanya no kwaabwa no kwafaniketwa konje.
Kakuli ka twaliketa kwiinu eyo imonahala, kono kwiinu no kwa monahala, kakuli einu eyo imonahala niya mu nako icana feela, kono einu no kwa monahala niya kuta oko no kwaabwa.
